nodes.name: Called by Ingest Workflow
nodes.notes: Triggered by Workflow 1 after a new file is ingested. Also runs on schedule as a catch-all.

nodes.name: Catch-All Schedule (30 min)
nodes.notes: Safety net: processes any files stuck in 'pending' status every 30 minutes.

parameters.query:
SELECT id, gdrive_file_id, original_filename, mime_type, local_path, is_video, taken_at, process_attempts
FROM media_files
WHERE status = 'pending'
  AND process_attempts < 3
ORDER BY ingested_at ASC
LIMIT 20;

nodes.name: Load Pending Media
nodes.notes: Fetches up to 20 unprocessed files. Skips files that have failed 3+ times.

parameters.query: UPDATE media_files SET status = 'processing', process_attempts = process_attempts + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = '{{ $json.id }}'::uuid AND status = 'pending' RETURNING *;

nodes.name: Mark Processing
nodes.notes: Immediately marks the file as 'processing' and increments attempt counter. If the pipeline fails after this point, the file won't be retried infinitely — it will hit the 3-attempt limit.

nodes.name: Is Video?
nodes.notes: Videos need keyframe extraction before face recognition.

nodes.name: Extract Video Keyframes
nodes.notes: Extracts up to 5 I-frames (keyframes) from the video using ffmpeg. These are used for face recognition only — the original video is what gets sent to friends.

nodes.name: Prepare Keyframe Items
nodes.notes: Splits keyframes into individual items for batch face recognition.

nodes.name: Read Keyframe from Disk
nodes.notes: Reads keyframe JPEG into n8n binary data so CompreFace can process it.

nodes.name: CompreFace: Recognize (Video Frames)
nodes.notes: Sends each keyframe binary to CompreFace for face recognition.

parameters.command:
=FILEPATH="{{ $json.local_path }}"
EXT=$(echo "$FILEPATH" | grep -oiE '\.(heic|heif)$' || true)
if [ -n "$EXT" ]; then
  OUTPATH="${FILEPATH}.converted.jpg"
  ffmpeg -y -i "$FILEPATH" -q:v 2 "$OUTPATH" 2>&1
  echo "$OUTPATH"
else
  echo "$FILEPATH"
fi

nodes.name: Convert HEIC if Needed
nodes.notes: iPhone photos are HEIC format which CompreFace cannot read. Converts to JPEG via ffmpeg. Non-HEIC files pass through unchanged. Outputs the path to use for recognition.

nodes.name: Read Converted Photo
nodes.notes: Reads the converted JPEG (or original file if no conversion was needed) into binary for CompreFace.

nodes.name: CompreFace: Recognize (Photo)
nodes.notes: Sends the photo binary to CompreFace for face recognition.

nodes.name: Parse Recognition Results
nodes.notes: Filters faces above confidence threshold, deduplicates across keyframes, extracts friend names.

parameters.query:
-- Race-safe session attach: uses advisory lock to prevent duplicate sessions
-- when multiple photos arrive simultaneously.
SELECT attach_to_session(
  '{{ $json.mediaId }}'::uuid,
  {{ $json.takenAt ? "'" + $json.takenAt + "'::timestamptz" : 'NOW()' }},
  6,
  ARRAY[{{ $json.friendsIdentified.map(f => "'" + f + "'").join(',') || '' }}]::text[]
) AS session_id;

nodes.name: Attach to Session (Race-Safe)
nodes.notes: Uses the attach_to_session() SQL function from 002_migrations.sql. Handles concurrent inserts via advisory lock — no duplicate sessions.

parameters.query:
UPDATE media_files SET
  faces_detected = {{ $('Parse Recognition Results').item.json.facesDetected || 0 }},
  faces_recognized = '{{ $('Parse Recognition Results').item.json.facesRecognized }}'::jsonb,
  friends_identified = ARRAY[{{ $('Parse Recognition Results').item.json.friendsIdentified.map(f => "'" + f + "'").join(',') || '' }}]::text[],
  status = 'processed',
  processed_at = NOW(),
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $('Parse Recognition Results').item.json.mediaId }}'::uuid;

nodes.name: Update Media Record
nodes.notes: Updates the media_files record with face recognition results and 'processed' status. Session was already assigned by attach_to_session().
